# pkg/v1/cache/

## Purpose

Public facade for the SDK's generic LRU + TTL cache (ADR 0027). Re-exports the
kernel primitive as **generic type aliases** (zero runtime cost) so consumers
depend only on `pkg/v1`. Stdlib-only → dep-light; cross-OS portable.

## Surface

| Symbol | Notes |
|---|---|
| `Cache[K,V]` / `Config[K,V]` / `Stats` | type aliases onto `internal/kernel/cache` (`Stats = StatsValue`) |
| `New[K,V](cfg)` | constructor (wraps `kernel/cache.NewCache`) |
| methods `Fetch`/`Set`/`SetTTL`/`Delete`/`Len`/`Purge`/`Stats` | inherited from the aliased type |

## Conventions

- **Type aliases, not new types** — `pkg/v1/cache.Cache[K,V]` IS the kernel type.
- **`Fetch`, not `Get`** (a hit mutates LRU) — see kernel CLAUDE.md.
- README generated by gomarkdoc; edit the `cache.go` doc comment + `make docs-readme`.

## Do NOT

- Reimplement eviction here — the facade is aliases + the `New` wrapper only.

## Verification

```
bazel test --config=race //pkg/v1/cache:cache_test
```
